name: deepseek-balance
description: Check the DeepSeek account balance (available / granted / topped-up) through a local MCP tool.

interface.shortDescription: Ask how much balance you have left
interface.longDescription: Adds a deepseek_balance tool that reads https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance with your own API key. Ask "还有多少钱" or "我的余额" and the model calls it instead of guessing. Ported from the deepseek-balance Claude Code mod, which drew the balance above the prompt; Codex has no such hook, so the same number is exposed as a tool.
